title: Impersonate user
subtitle: Temporarily access the application as another user for support and testing.

select.title: Select a user
select.description: Choose an active account. Your administrator session will be preserved and restored when you stop impersonating.

errors.missingSession: The original administrator session could not be preserved.

securityNote: All actions are performed with the target user's permissions. The administrator remains recorded as the actor in the audit log.
